answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can leverage Proof of Costly Resource Acquisition. Each agent must demonstrate ownership of a unique, verifiable resource whose initial acquisition has a high, market-determined economic cost. This creates a significant economic barrier, akin to conquering a digital dune or mining a rare element from a virtual tundra. The system then validates this unique resource ownership, ensuring a distinct identity pulse. An attacker must incur this substantial economic burden for every fake identity, making large-scale Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
